audit.why: TF out-shoves from 2 with Wild Cards + Stacked Deck; 3-5 is even around Rebuttal/Solar Snare; Destiny and first item punish a dash-less Mel; her Overwhelm execute and reflect out-scale at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty misgendered fields (Mel is she/her); breakdown.cooldowns had no number; two dos/donts bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim; the W reflect interaction with TF's Q/red-card projectiles was stated but without its 38s rank-1 cooldown.
audit.why: Rebuttal 38/35/33/29/26s, Solar Snare 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s per Riot data — the reflect downtime is the whole trade pattern for a projectile-based owner.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed everywhere lint flagged; cooldowns field now carries 38s/11s; bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles.
